name: boat-broken-by-rider
comment: WP-4.8. The pool of entity/boat-player-ride: the player (id 0) gets into the boat (id 1) with the interact op at t = 5, then punches the boat it rides at t = 8, 9, 10 (attack op with attacker_id 0: Minecraft.clickMouse(0), EntityPlayer.attackTargetEntityWithCurrentItem; a fist does 1, +1 while motionY < 0, so 20 boat damage a hit, EntityBoat.java:67, less 1 a tick). The third hit passes 40: EntityBoat.attackEntityFrom puts the rider off with riddenByEntity.mountEntity(this) (the dismount branch of Entity.mountEntity: the player set on top of the boat, Entity.java:992-995), drops 3 planks and 2 sticks and dies (EntityBoat.java:69-84). The port's player is out of its slot during its own attack; before WP-4.8 the boat recorded that and the player stayed on the dead boat, then left it in place in the next updateEntities. entity_state of the player and the boat and rng_state every tick.
